name: choruz-archive-agent-notes
title_zh: Agent Notes 增删改查前先查有没有被新记录
tagline_zh: 往仓库里加一条 Agent Note 之前，它先翻一遍现有记录：有没有已被新决策顶掉的旧条目。
tagline_en: Before you add an Agent Note, it scans existing records for superseded entries, implemented notes worth keeping.
desc_en: Use when adding, auditing, pruning, archiving, restoring, or reviewing Agent Notes in this repository; checks every new note for superseded active records, classifies implemented notes by future decision value, deletes rejected notes that no longer prevent a tempting mistake, and applies the frozen archived/{class} rules.
why_zh: 它把「加一条」当成「改一整套」：新记录进来先看顶掉了谁，已实现的按未来决策价值分档。
why_en: Treats every addition as a full-set edit: checks what the new note supersedes, grades implemented notes by future decision.
limit_zh: 只在这个仓库的 Agent Notes 目录里工作，不碰代码、不碰 issue。
limit_en: Works only inside this repo's Agent Notes directory, not code or issues; archived/{class} rules are frozen; it only suggests classifications and.
title_en: Audit Agent Notes for superseded records before adding or.
